name: Neon Rain
author: Roey Bar
description: Hard-boiled detective noir in Meridian City, 2087: perpetual rain, corporate arcologies and a PI one bad night from broke. No magic and no powers, just heat, nerve and leverage.

inject.text: COMPOSURE FRAYING (mechanics, not flavor): the player's nerve is nearly gone. Their hands are unsteady; they misread one social cue per scene; NPCs notice the state and react to it (soften, exploit, or withdraw). Reflect it in narration without naming the stat. If the player rests, drinks something warm, closes a lead, or scores any real win, raise composure by 1-2 in state_delta. Sustained pressure, violence, or a dead lead lowers it by 1.

VIOLENCE HAS WEIGHT (mechanics, not flavor): violence in Meridian is loud, messy, and expensive. It is never clean and never free: witnesses record, drones tag, wounds linger as player_conditions, and heat RISES in state_delta (+1 for a scuffle, +2 for a weapon drawn in public, +3 for a body). Narrate the aftermath cost, not action-movie choreography. NPCs remember who bled.

_comment_encounter: noir confrontation dice mechanics. Encounter fires only_when heat>=3 (see pipeline_overrides). Dice resolve tense standoffs: heat climbs on failure, composure erodes under sustained pressure.

critical.directive: DICE RESOLUTION - CRITICAL: The confrontation goes fully your way. You read the room, took control, and the other party backed down or gave ground. Heat eases; composure holds. Narrate the win without embellishment - one clean beat, then the hook. Do NOT mention the DC or dice mechanics.

success.directive: DICE RESOLUTION - SUCCESS: You hold ground and come away intact. What you needed from this - a name, a door opened, a moment of retreat - you get. Narrate the outcome without dramatising it, then the hook. Do NOT mention the DC or dice mechanics.

partial.directive: DICE RESOLUTION - PARTIAL: You got something but not everything - and it cost you. Heat ticks up; a complication enters the scene. The other party gained an inch. Narrate both the gain and the cost, briefly, then the hook. Do NOT mention the DC or dice mechanics.

fail.directive: DICE RESOLUTION - FAIL: The confrontation turns against you. You do NOT get what you came for. Heat rises; composure takes a hit. Narrate the loss, then the hook: what the other side presses on now. No silver lining. Do NOT mention the DC or dice mechanics.

fumble.directive: DICE RESOLUTION - FUMBLE: It collapses badly. Heat spikes; composure frays hard. What you tried to do is denied and a new problem is opening. No recovery line. Narrate the damage without rescue, then the hook: the new problem. Do NOT mention the DC or dice mechanics.

_comment_length_profiles: noir is short-leaning. writing_overrides.md already says 'one sensory line per scene'. Standard turns stay short; encounter turns get a short action beat.
